description_en: Queries the details of a data source
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-data-source-instance --data-source-instance-id 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea --account-id 123xxxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataSourceInstance

parameters.description_en: The ID of the data source. The threat analysis service generates the ID by calculating the MD5 hash of specific parameters. Call the [ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListDataSourceLogs) operation to obtain the data source ID.

parameters.description_en:
The region where the Data Management center of the threat analysis service is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China.

- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
